_note: The anti-hallucination contract, measured over every research JSON in the corpus. A null is an explicit 'not found' written by the agent instead of a guess. Values themselves are not included - only how many there were and how they were sourced.

_provenance.produced_by: aggregate scan of the corpus research JSONs

contract_drift.shape_of_the_drift: free-text descriptions written in place of the enum (partial results, counts of profiles found, HTTP status notes)
contract_drift.why_it_happened: the enum lives in a prose protocol file and no code validates it; validate_data.py checks that required FIELDS are present, never that a value is one of the three allowed
